newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen falling.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.07 down at 41.55 to the dollar in the kerb market on Friday amid low dollar supplies from the Gulf, dealers said.
The rupee was likely to open lower on Saturday owing to short supplies, a dealer said.
The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rupee rate, last changed on May 23, was 40.3900/40.5920 against the dollar.
The premium on the foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 2.75 percent compared to the opening at 2.80 percent.
